payload.next_step_hint: With "Implement edit_tasks batch proposal generation tool" complete, multi-task proposal generation (batched payloads and atomic outcomes) is available; the immediate option is to implement the centralized proposal payload validation engine ("Implement proposal payload validation engine") to standardize schema, permission, and metadata checks across single- and multi-task proposals.

next_step_options.tradeoffs: Centralizing validation with "Implement proposal payload validation engine" delivers consistent rules, reduces duplicated validation logic across "Implement edit_task proposal generation tool" and "Implement edit_tasks batch proposal generation tool", and lowers downstream bugs, but requires upfront design, may force refactors of existing generators to call the engine, and introduces additional runtime/latency considerations and a need for well-defined error-reporting contracts (including batch atomicity semantics).
next_step_options.description: Implement the proposal payload validation engine ("Implement proposal payload validation engine"): build a centralized validator that enforces the proposal schemas, verifies referenced entities exist, checks change permissions, ensures required metadata and requestor-context presence/format, and produces structured per-proposal and batch-level validation results usable by both single-task ("Implement edit_task proposal generation tool") and multi-task ("Implement edit_tasks batch proposal generation tool") generators.

step_priority_hints.executionInsight: Lock field names and entity reference formats in "Proposal Payload Schema and Validation Design" now to avoid incompatible schema changes during implementation.

Ensure "Implement Proposal entity, model, and endpoints" exposes permission checks and stable reference APIs to prevent rework in "Implement edit_task proposal generation tool", "Implement edit_tasks batch proposal generation tool", "Implement proposal payload validation engine" and "Implement API service proposal validation endpoints".

Delay finalizing "Implement edit_task proposal generation tool" until "Implement Proposal entity, model, and endpoints"'s model shape is stable so payload construction aligns with the canonical entities.

Define batch atomicity and error semantics now so "Implement edit_tasks batch proposal generation tool" can integrate cleanly with "Implement Proposal entity, model, and endpoints" and "Implement proposal payload validation engine" once available.

Implement schema-versioning and clear error codes in "Implement proposal payload validation engine" to make validation consumable by "Implement edit_task proposal generation tool"/"Implement edit_tasks batch proposal generation tool" and "Implement API service proposal validation endpoints".

Build "Implement requestor context extraction and embedding" to capture requestor metadata now; it can be integrated into payloads with minimal changes once "Implement Proposal entity, model, and endpoints" finalizes payload fields.

Design "Implement API service proposal validation endpoints" to surface "Implement proposal payload validation engine" validation results with stable error schemas so callers can handle retries and conflicts consistently.

payload.verification_guidance: From "Implement edit_tasks batch proposal generation tool" you can verify that the system can produce multi-task proposal payloads that reference multiple entities, include embedded requestor context and change metadata, and expose batch-level outcomes (success or atomic failure) with per-item error details.
